PURPOSE AND OWNERSHIP

This bead owns the StoryAtlas consumer seam for lowering a durable typed story-output result into a portable bundle with an obvious preview.html entry point. The scientific contract remains in storymodel4s: canonical model bytes, source and canonical text identities, typed universe and semantic outcomes, per-projection and per-report dispositions, admitted provenance, and receipts. StoryAtlas may package and render those facts; it may not infer causality, chronology, eligibility, absence, evidence, privacy permission, or authority.

CURRENT BASELINE

At StoryAtlas base 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5, Edition.build is all-or-nothing, hardcodes ResearcherReviewedFixture, and Main accepts only the War of the Ghosts fixture. The exact provider specification with SHA-256 53ab5245917351268b45d2b6765ddf6f67324131bfc1bdf8da184edbabba9b7f received independent off-tree acceptance, but no durable provider API candidate or authorized final public vocabulary exists yet.

ENTRY GATE

No implementation against provider bundle names begins until a reviewed, authorized, reachable storymodel4s candidate supplies the relevant types/codecs and settles failure and dependency behavior. Local dependency bd-01M1C2TV1SJECKEQ6SNVSRBTHQ carries that adoption gate. Foreign epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ and discussion posts are provenance only, never cross-store dependency edges.

BUNDLE CONTRACT

- Preserve valid semantic and other produced roles when one report or HTML lowering fails; do not collapse a partial result into total failure.
- Emit or explicitly account for source.txt, canonical.txt, storymodel.json, result.json, preview.txt, preview.html, manifest.json, and any authorized local assets by typed role.
- Expose profile outcomes and failures explicitly rather than infer certification from file presence or bytes.
- Keep Address and standoff identities stable through every rendering. Renderer data-name identities remain MarkId, AnnotationId, or FragmentId as appropriate.
- Keep exact source/canonical text as DOM or text-file content, never copied into the shell or inferred from renderer marks.

CANONICAL STATIC PREVIEW

preview.html is the strict static publication profile: self-contained HTML/CSS with inline SVG as document content, no JavaScript, no inline event handlers, no external resources, no CDN/font dependency, and no fetch dependence on sibling bundle roles. It opens by ordinary filesystem action with no build, server, terminal step, or installation. The richer interactive application is a separate target and cannot weaken this profile. Local dependency bd-01M1C2TTHJRV7BWMQMPS7ENR1D establishes this publication compiler over current view artifacts before provider integration.

ACCEPTANCE

- Adapt the landed provider contract without duplicating provider semantics or silently substituting fallback values.
- Preserve partial successes, provenance, missingness, alternatives, requested-layer disposition, profile outcomes, and deterministic receipts.
- Add malformed-boundary, mutation, identity, textual-twin, direct-file, no-network, and no-script courts.
- Pass compileAll, testAll, scalafmtCheckAll, app/fastLinkJS, the static preview court, and applicable product-controlled browser checks under exact sibling overrides.
- Record StoryAtlas SHA, provider SHA, source reachability, and local versus hosted evidence separately.

RELATED EXPERIMENT

The O3 relation presentation comparison is separate bead bd-01M1C2TTW0S3HA4HDDVWQKWEYM and holds the typed packet, requested-layer accounting, and repeated-endpoint fixture constant.

Promoted from discussion post post-01M19JQBJJ5TBMKVWRA3J7HJP0 in topic story-output-bundle-lowering.
